intro.text: A Skimmer and a member of the Set.

items.text: Fed, a low-ranking member of the Set, was part of the Set group that travelled to the Sovereign's temple in the Seran Range. After Wax received the Bands of Mourning there, the group's leader escaped the temple by airship, and Fed's Feruchemy primed the machinery that altered the ship's weight so it could take off.
